notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Version 1.03 Release Notes
Saturday September 21th, 2019

Hello,

This patch introduce better controls over your paddle with sharper movements and the ability to change its sensitivity.
To avoid the ball being stuck with a repeated repulsive cloud influence, the cloud now introduce some force angle variations on its borders. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35406607/f0d655e0630c33e4e85a3f681f9efd0bcd04c516.png

Game Balance:

Sharper paddle movements.
3 differents influence zone in the repulse cloud, with an upward force on center and a -10 degree and +10 degree on borders.


Game Settings:

5 differents paddle sensitivity are now available in the settings.

notes.title: Patch v1.02 New Drops.
notes.notes:
Version 1.02 Release Notes
Friday July 26th, 2019

Hello,

A first patch introducing two new bad drops, in order to match the number of good drops and balance the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35406607/afb463de6033e9b17220a14239c64937315ca280.jpg

Game Balance: 2 New drops

Freeze: Slows down your paddle for 2 seconds.
Death: Removes one life.


Thanks all for your interest, happy gaming and thanks for your support!
